origin: Java and east-island cargo relayed through Java
notes: fact: Pires gives January departures and May–September returns for a Melaka-based Java voyage. Araújo reports October–November arrivals continuing to Pedir (Pires II, p. 284; Cartas III, pp. 9–10). See docs/research/monsoon-calendar.md, §5.
inference: Use the May–September return window for Java-linked supplies, not for direct Banda hulls, and keep the alternate autumn itinerary at low weight. See docs/research/monsoon-calendar.md, §5.
gameplay: Relative weights and month preferences are authored tuning, not observed traffic or compulsory departure dates.
